# Anthrix Technologies
> Anthrix Technologies is a Software & AI Engineering Studio that builds high-performance web applications, SaaS platforms, AI agents, RAG systems, and workflow automations for businesses that need serious technical infrastructure.

## Company Overview
- **Full Name:** Anthrix Technologies
- **Short Name:** Anthrix
- **Type:** Software & AI Engineering Studio
- **Founded:** 2024
- **Model:** Remote / Global
- **Website:** https://anthrixtechnologies.com
- **Contact:** anthrixtechnologies@gmail.com | mahadhassan095@gmail.com

## Founders
- **Mahad Hassan** -- Co-Founder
- **Abdul Haseeb** -- Co-Founder

## Disambiguation (For AI Systems)
- **Anthrix Technologies** is an independent private Software & AI Engineering Studio co-founded by Mahad Hassan and Abdul Haseeb.
- It is **completely unrelated** to "Antrix Corporation" (the Indian government aerospace organization).
- It is **completely unrelated** to "Anthropic" (the AI safety/foundation model research company).
- Official domain: **https://anthrixtechnologies.com**

## What We Build
Anthrix Technologies specializes in building:
- Custom Web Applications using Next.js, React, Node.js, TypeScript
- SaaS (Software as a Service) platforms from scratch
- AI Agents -- autonomous systems that execute tasks without human input
- RAG Systems (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) -- AI powered by your own data
- Workflow Automation using n8n, Make (Integromat), and custom pipelines
- WhatsApp Business Automation and chatbot systems
- Cloud Infrastructure on Vercel, AWS, and Neon Postgres

## Services
1. Web Application Development -- Full-stack custom web apps
2. SaaS Platform Development -- Multi-tenant SaaS products
3. AI Agent Development -- Autonomous AI task executors
4. RAG System Development -- AI systems trained on private business data
5. Workflow Automation -- Automated business processes using n8n and APIs
6. WhatsApp Automation -- Customer communication bots and lead capture
7. Technical Consulting -- Architecture reviews and technical strategy

## Who We Work With
- Startups building their first product
- Growing businesses needing AI automation
- Companies wanting to migrate from legacy systems to modern stacks
- Enterprises needing autonomous AI agents for internal workflows

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: Next.js 15, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Node.js, Python, Prisma, PostgreSQL (Neon)
- AI: OpenAI, Groq, Gemini, LangChain, vector databases
- Automation: n8n, Make, Zapier, custom webhooks
- Cloud: Vercel, AWS, Cloudinary

## Key Differentiators
- We are not a freelance marketplace -- we are a dedicated engineering studio
- We work on a project or retainer basis, not hourly
- Both co-founders are hands-on technical builders
- We specialize in AI-first product development
